messages:
raj: FYIwe're pausing the release train immediately due to a regional latency regression affecting model-routing in us-west-2. Observed 3x P95 increase for routed inference requests and a couple of spilled KV-cache evictions. Pause window estimated 24	60h depending on remediation. Please stop new submissions to the train until we update. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] routing-check: increased tail latency detected in us-west-2. 18/200 routing-probes above threshold. See: https://internal.metrics/routing/us-west-2

taylor: Is Dedicated impacted or is this only shared routing? Our staging canaries are failing on cold-start latency.

ops-oncall: Shared routing layer is impacted. Dedicated reserved pools continue to serve pinned models normally, but any traffic hitting multi-tenant routing may see elevated latency. If you depend on predictable latency, file an infra-alloc ticket and tag @ops-oncall. :eyes:

hannah: New temporary policy: effective now, if regional routing P95 > 2x baseline for >15m, the train auto-pauses and disables ramping for that region. This reduces blast radius for rollouts. Exceptions only for verified P0 hotfixes.

release-manager: Exception process: open a release-exception issue on the release-train board, label `urgent-hotfix`, include reason + customer impact, and ping @release-manager + @ops-oncall. We'll triage within 30 minutes. Only approve if the change bypasses routing (e.g., targeted model swap) or fixes a P0 regression.

raj: Mitigation plan underway  1) temporary traffic-steering to eu-west-1 for non-data-localized canaries, 2) rolling restart of the routing proxy fleet in us-west-2, 3) KV-cache eviction thresholds adjusted to reduce thrashing. We'll start traffic-steering in 10m.

release-manager: To mark a canary as non-movable, comment on the canary ticket with `locality: must-stay`. All others are eligible for reassignment. Owners will get DM from the bot.

deploy-bot: Useful commands:
```
rictl routing status --region=us-west-2
rictl canary migrate --id=<canary-id> --target=eu-west-1
```

taylor: If we migrate canaries, is there a data residency checklist? Some tests assume us-west dataset access.

ops-oncall: Migration notes: moved canaries will use snapshot-based test fixtures. If your test requires live-data locality, mark it with `locality: must-stay` and we'll exclude it from the automated migration.

raj: I'll post a 2-hour status update or earlier if the restart and steering reduce P95. Thanks for quick responses  please drop any urgent exception requests here and tag people explicitly. :thumbsup:
